scope: Manual visual inspection of current mobile and desktop screenshots, not a whole-site accessibility certification.
findings: Bitcost lesson has readable synthetic comparisons and visible kit/instructions controls.
Tail guide shows its exact source identity, readable actions and bounded-evidence notice at both sizes.
Seven estimate rows become labelled cards on mobile and a semantic table on desktop.
Long identifiers wrap after the responsive heading fix; automated 320, 390 and 1440 width checks pass with JavaScript on and off.
Displayed estimates remain explicitly separate from collision witnesses, proved sampling laws and confidence coverage.
